title: Signed double Roos interchange and tensor augmentation coherence
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings with exact countable products of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use unbounded complexes and derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the strict Roos model $\mathsf R(X)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s:\prod X_i\to\prod X_i)[-1]$ [def-weil-strict-roos-model], in coordinates $(v,u)$ with differential $(dv,-du-(1-s)v)$, and total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves].

For every strict double inverse sequence $X_{n,j}$ of unbounded $R$-complexes with commuting transitions, coordinate interchange $\prod_n\prod_j X_{n,j}^a\cong\prod_j\prod_n X_{n,j}^a$, multiplied by $(-1)^{pq}$ on Roos degrees $(p,q)\in\{0,1\}^2$, is a natural chain isomorphism
$$\beta_X:\mathsf R_n\mathsf R_jX_{n,j}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathsf R_j\mathsf R_nX_{n,j}.$$
It is compatible with strict maps and with evaluations in Roos degree zero. It induces the same signed isomorphism of iterated total derived limits under the normalized strict Roos comparison [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison].

More specifically let $t\in\Gamma(\mathcal C,R)$, $L_j=[R\xrightarrow{t^j}R]$ with transitions $(t,1)$ in degrees $[-1,0]$ [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers], and let $Q_n$ be any strict tower of unbounded complexes. Put $H_0=\mathsf R_n Q_n$, $C(P)=\mathsf R_j(P\otimes_RL_j)$, and let $u_P:P\to C(P)$ have components $p\mapsto p\otimes1$ and zero shifted $j$-component. The coordinate identifications give chain isomorphisms
$$\gamma_j:H_0\otimes_RL_j\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathsf R_n(Q_n\otimes_RL_j)$$
natural in $Q$ and compatible with the $j$-transitions, inclusions, and evaluations at $n$. The composite
$$H_0\xrightarrow{\mathsf R_n(u_{Q_n})}\mathsf R_n C(Q_n)\xrightarrow{\beta}\mathsf R_j\mathsf R_n(Q_n\otimes_RL_j)\xrightarrow{\mathsf R_j(\gamma^{-1})}C(H_0)$$
is exactly $u_{H_0}$. After $\beta$, its coordinates with $j$-Roos degree $q=1$ vanish; those with $q=0$ and $n$-Roos degree $p=0,1$ are the respective coordinates of $H_0$ followed by the degree-zero Koszul inclusion. No torsion, regularity, normalization or boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use [lem-sp-signed-double-roos-interchange-core] for beta, its signed four-coordinate formula and the two strict evaluation squares. These are exactly the first three clauses.

For arbitrary derived comparison isomorphisms rho_nj and rho_jn, take delta to be rho_nj inverse followed by Q(beta) followed by rho_jn, the existing derivedInterchange. Associativity and rho_nj hom-inverse cancellation prove the displayed equality. This is purely functorial localization and does not require invoking the normalized strict Roos comparison theorem.

Apply [lem-sp-signed-double-roos-tensor-core] to the same beta and its signed coordinate formula. Its eta, tau, gamma and eight compatibility clauses give the entire remaining tensor/augmentation conclusion. Combine the results as a conjunction without any change to the parent statement.
